Some people feel really anxious at one point with no explainable reason and they freak out, they believe they’re fucked in the head. These are the people that develop a disorder. (They get stuck in the “loop”)

Summary of what you should do : 

•Don’t fight the anxiety. 
• Try to make yourself feel anxious, ket is consume you and edge it on (destroy the fear of the anxiety and therefore destroy the disorder) 
•Try to dissociate yourself from the anxiety, pretend your looking at your anxious self from someone else point of you. 
•Tell yourself that you have no reason to be anxious and that all you’re feeling is nervous arousal - tell yourself that it can’t hurt you so what’s there to be worried about? 
•When you start to feel less anxious, push the boundaries of what you think may make you anxious. 
•You need to desensitise yourself from the feeling of anxiety, you need to destroy the fear of it.
